messages:
Sasha: Heads-up — our KPI dashboard shows +12% MQLs this week but webinar registrations are flat. looks like the top funnel metric and inbound leads are decoupled. Anybody else seeing this?
Marta: yep saw that. suspect attribution window shift. we moved to 30d default last month; webinar credits were 7d previously. could double-count organic in 30d for MQLs
Jay: strong hypothesis. quick check: can we compare 'last touch 7d' vs 'last touch 30d' cohorts for the past 4 weeks? if the gap appears only in 30d that pins it
Oliver: I pulled a quick cohort query — returns counts by attribution window. paste below:
```
SELECT attribution_window, COUNT(DISTINCT lead_id) as mqls
FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY attribution_window
```
results: 7d=420, 30d=538
Priya: thanks. that +118 looks like the source reattribution. which sources grew? organic search +44, content +35, webinar +2
Sasha: oh interesting. webinar is actually flat in raw register numbers but MQLs rose because content & organic got credited. so our webinar ROI in dashboard is understated if people later touch content and convert
Marta: maybe update dashboards to show both 'strict last-touch 7d' and 'multi-touch 30d' side-by-side for the KPI review. also add a flag for "registrations -> mql conversion within 7d"
Jay: agree. also recommend a small blurb in the weekly KPI deck explaining the attribution change and impact on the MQL delta. otherwise execs will chase the wrong root cause
Marketing-bot: Reminder: Weekly KPI review in #marketing on Tue 09:00 PT — attach final deck 24h prior :bell:
Oliver: I'll update the dashboard widgets and drop the new breakdown into the deck. linking the temp dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/8a1/webinar-kpis?org=redwood
Priya: put me on the slide to narrate the source shift and include the cohort numbers. i'll also add the 'lookback sensitivity' note
Sasha: thanks team. Last ask — can we add a one-click filter on the dashboard to toggle attribution window between 7d/30d? that'll make on-call triage easier
Oliver: yep, will add toggle + tooltip explaining expected churn effects. target: EOD Monday
Sasha: perfect. heading into prep — will draft a 2-bullet explanation for the deck and ping for review
Jay: thumbs up :thumbsup:
Marta: LGTM
Marketing-bot: Deck uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/kpi-weekly/2026-03-24-deck.pdf
